{{CharInfobox |color={{contest color}} |corecolor={{contest color light}} |bordercolor={{contest color dark}} |name=Keira |jname=ミミィ |tmname=Mimmy |image=Keira Adventures.png |size=200px |caption=Keira in [[Pokémon Adventures]] |hometown=Unknown |region=[[Sinnoh]] |game=yes |generation={{gen|IV}}, {{gen|VIII}} |games={{game3|Diamond and Pearl|Diamond, Pearl|s}}, {{v2|Platinum}}, {{pkmn|Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl|Brilliant Diamond, Shining Pearl}} |gender=Female }} '''Keira''' (Japanese: '''ミミィ''' ''Mimmy'') is a character in {{game2|Diamond|Pearl|Platinum}}. She is one of the judges of the [[Pokémon Super Contest]]s. Her appearance is designed after the {{tc|Idol}} {{DL|Pokémon Trainer|Trainer class}}. ==In the games== Keira is a member of the panel of judges for the [[Pokémon Super Contest]]s. She seems to be friends with [[Johanna]]. When entering [[Hearthome City]] for the first time, the {{player}} comes across Keira's {{p|Buneary}}, which is being chased by her {{pkmn|Trainer}}. After reclaiming her Buneary, Keira thanks the player and asks them to visit her at the [[Contest Hall|Super Contest Hall]]. There, Keira is seen talking with Johanna. She rewards the player with a [[Accessory#Massage Accessories|Glitter Powder]] and wonders if they will be the next big Contest star. ===Pokémon=== {| style="float:left; width: 96px" |- | {{InactivePoké|Keira|Buneary|427Buneary.png|normal|size=80px|link=no}} | |}{{left clear}} ===Items given=== {{Itlisth|normal}} {{Itemlist|Glitter Powder|sprite=Accessory Glitter Powder Sprite|In the [[Contest Hall|Super Contest Hall]]|D=yes|P=yes|Pt=yes|display=[[Accessory#Massage Accessories|Glitter Powder]]}} {{Itlistfoot|normal}} ===Quotes=== '''[[Hearthome City]]''' : ''"Oh, thank goodness that you happened to be there! {{color2|000|Generation IV}} |} ==In the manga== [[File:Keira DPA.png|thumb|200px|Keira in Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!]] ===Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!=== In the [[Pokémon Diamond and Pearl Adventure!]] {{pkmn|manga}}, Keira appeared in ''[[DPA06|Beauty Contest: The Pokémon Super Contest!!]]'' along with her fellow judges during a [[Pokémon Super Contest]] in which [[Hareta]] and {{OBP|Jun|DPA}} were participating. She was not pleased with their performance in the [[Dance Competition]]. ===Pokémon Adventures=== ===={{MangaArc|Diamond & Pearl}}==== Keira makes her first appearance in ''[[PS350|Boogying with Buneary]]'', where she picks up her Buneary that had run off earlier and punched {{adv|Pearl}} in the jaw. She apologizes and makes up for it by giving Pearl a [[Accessory#Massage Accessories|Glitter Powder]]. She and her Buneary appear again in ''[[PS351|Perturbed by Pachirisu]]'', judging the [[Rank (Contest)|Normal Rank]] [[Cool (condition)|Coolness Contest]]. She is later seen with her fellow judges at the [[Lost Tower]] after having been sent there because of the fight between {{p|Dialga}} and {{p|Palkia}} that caused time and space to distort. ====Pokémon==== {{TrainerPoké |trainer=Keira |pkmn=Buneary |nick=Earma |cynick=Bunnie |gender=female |type1=Normal |img=Keira Buneary Adventures.png |epnum=PS350 |epname=Boogying with Buneary |desc={{p|Buneary|Earma}} (Japanese: '''みみぃ''' ''Mimmy'') is Keira's only known Pokémon. She first appears as she ran off, with {{adv|Pearl}} mistaking her as a [[wild Pokémon]]. Pearl gives Earma a [[Berry]] only for her to retaliate by punching Pearl in the jaw. This made Pearl want to catch her. However, Earma was very fast. Both {{TP|Platinum|Prinplup}} and [[Chimler]] give chase to Earma, with Prinplup doing it for different reasons. Earma went in the {{pkmn|Super Contest}} building and was reunited with Keira afterwards. She was with Keira in ''[[PS351|Perturbed by Pachirisu]]'' while she was judging the Contest. None of Earma's moves are known.}} ==Trivia== *In the Japanese version of the [[Pokémon Adventures]] manga, Earma's nickname sounds exactly the same as Keira's name, with the only difference being that Earma's name is spelled in hiragana, while Keira's is in katakana. ==Names== {| class="roundtable" style="background:#{{contest color}}; border:3px solid #{{contest color dark}}" |- ! style="background:#{{contest color light}}" | Language ! style="background:#{{contest color light}}" | Name ! style="background:#{{contest color light}}" | Origin |- | Japanese | ミミィ ''Mimmy'' | Possibly from ミミロル ''Mimirol'' ({{p|Buneary}}) |- | English, Brazilian Portuguese | Keira | Similar to ''ear'' |- | German | Julia | |- | European Spanish | Telma | |- | French | Karine | Similar to her English name |- | Italian | Ileana | |- | Korean | 미혜 ''Mihye'' | Similar to her Japanese name |- | Chinese (Traditional) | 蜜蜜 ''Mìmì'' / ''Mahtmaht'' | rowspan="2" | Transcription of her Japanese name |- | Chinese (Simplified) | 蜜蜜 ''Mìmì'' |- | Vietnamese | Mimi | Transcription of her Japanese name |} {{-}} ==Related articles== {{Super Contests Judges}} {{NPC|contest|sinnoh=yes}} {{Project CharacterDex notice}} [[Category:Diamond and Pearl characters]] [[Category:Platinum characters]] [[Category:Brilliant Diamond and Shining Pearl characters]] [[Category:Pokémon Adventures characters]] [[Category:Pokémon DP Adventure characters]] [[de:Julia (Sinnoh)]] [[es:Telma (juez)]] [[it:Ileana]] [[ja:ミミィ]] [[zh:蜜蜜]]
